_comment: Registry of Never Ending Story worlds. To light up a new world: flip its status to 'live', set url + data, then hand-craft its island SVG art in index.html to the aesthetic bar. Bespoke art stays hand-built — only the wiring/metadata lives here.

islands.name: Tropicana
islands.blurb: A deserted island where castaways find each other.

islands.name: Driving Dead
islands.blurb: A couple in a solar camper van, dug in on a rooftop above a dead city.

islands.blurb: Two Singaporeans & a cat, stranded deep in the Malaysian jungle.
